title: Out of Sight
card: A robot's brain keeps a map of where everything is, even what its camera cannot see.
tagline: Hide the hand, and the brain knows where it is
kicker: A MAP OF THE WORLD IN THE BRAIN'S OWN STATE
feature: The robot sees only part of the room. Its brain keeps a live map of what is where, in its own state, and holds a hidden thing where it can be: a person's hand within 11 cm, its own hand within half a millimetre.
howTo: Drag the hand behind the pillar. Drag the floor to turn the robot away from the apple. Click a thing to ask the brain where it is. Switch to the robot's own hand and click a shadow.
